meta.title: CORA - Freezing a card, step by step

views.label: Who are you
views.note: The customer must prove their identity before anything else happens.

views.label: What is allowed
views.note: A fixed rulebook, not the AI, decides this needs an explicit confirmation.

views.label: Do and double-check
views.note: CORA changes the card only after a yes, then re-checks before telling the customer.

messages.label: Yes - and only their own cards
messages.note: If the login is missing or expired, CORA stops here and shares nothing.

messages.label: What should happen for this request?
Allowed, but ask the customer first
messages.note: The rulebook, not the AI, makes this call - so it is predictable and auditable.

messages.label: Re-read: is it really frozen now?
Confirmed frozen
messages.note: If the re-check fails, CORA says it was NOT done and offers a human agent.

cards.title: Identity comes first
items: Nothing is read or changed until the customer is verified
A customer can only ever touch their own cards

cards.title: The rulebook decides, not the AI
items: Fixed rules choose: answer, confirm, escalate or refuse
A sensitive action always needs an explicit yes

cards.title: Verify before telling
items: The card changes only after the customer confirms
CORA re-reads it; if anything is off, it offers a human
